summary: Reliance Global Group disclosed in an 8-K that its non-binding LOI to sell Altruis Benefit Consulting's operating assets was terminated on August 14, 2026, and a new LOI with a different buyer was signed on August 27. No financial terms were disclosed; the new deal is subject to due diligence and definitive agreements. The board previously recommended the sale; no advisors named. Watch for definitive agreement execution and any regulatory approvals, as the prior termination introduces execution risk.
